name: Andaz Scottsdale Resort & Spa
positioning: Sonoran Desert resort in Scottsdale (officially Andaz Scottsdale Resort & Bungalows) with a desert-botanical spa, Palo Verde Spa & Apothecary
best_for: Travelers who want a spa and wellness stay in the Sonoran Desert
Guests interested in fitness classes and guided outdoor wellness programming

facts.text: The property's official name is Andaz Scottsdale Resort & Bungalows.
The resort's spa, Palo Verde Spa & Apothecary, is rooted in the Sonoran Desert surrounding Scottsdale.
Palo Verde Spa & Apothecary offers desert botanicals, grounding rituals and restorative treatments.
The spa offers a salt stone massage.
The spa offers a cactus facial.
The spa offers hair, nail and body treatments.
The resort's Fitness Center and spa lawns host complimentary and paid wellness experiences throughout the week, from fitness and movement classes to guided outdoor programming.
The resort describes its fitness and wellness setting with morning light over Camelback Mountain and desert air.
Private cabanas sit beside the spa pool, with shaded lounge seating and chilled drinks.
A Palo Verde Spa membership gives members exclusive access to spa amenities and preferred pricing on services.

highlights.text: Palo Verde Spa & Apothecary draws on desert botanicals, grounding rituals and restorative treatments.
Private cabanas beside the spa pool offer shaded lounge seating and chilled drinks.
The Mindful Journey Retreat is a three-day retreat program built around art, nature, food and exercise.
The Fitness Center and spa lawns host complimentary and paid wellness experiences through the week, from movement classes to guided outdoor programming.

considerations.text: The spa recommends reserving appointments in advance.
WhataHotel notes the desert climate may be intense during the summer months.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
